Zero Conditional with When
Use zero conditional with when to express information about specific situations that commonly have a cause and effect.

In order to analyze the zero conditional, we must know what the conditional mood is.

We can see the conditional mood as a set of sentences showing the relation between facts (real or hypothetical) and their conditions.

Therefore, a conditional sentence has two clauses or ideas; the main clause (idea) or the effect and the if clause or conditional clause.

We can use the zero conditional to express ideas that are always true, that means factual ideas that always take place when something happens.

Both clauses or ideas in zero conditional have the verbs in present form; the conditional clause goes with “if” or “when" and the main clause goes in simple present.

Structure:

  1. If/when + present simple + , + present simple.
  2. Present simple + if/when + present simple.
Examples:

  • If you have problems with the databases, create a database warehouse.
  • Don't relay in one database for your company if you want to make things easy for the other dependencies.

    Notice that when the if/when clause goes first, you need to add a comma “,” to separate both ideas, but when you start the idea with the main clause, you don't need to add a comma to separate the ideas.
The sales manager and the CEO need some specific information from the database, but when I gather it from their computers, it is quite different.
When there are too many dependencies in a company, the information they have may differ from the others.
When we use data warehousing, it compiles all the data the company has from its different dependencies and databases.
Subject and Object Pronouns Review
Use object and subject pronouns to replace nouns (names of people or things) so that you avoid redundancy in your text.

Pronouns are words that you can use to replace a noun in a sentence. Such Pronouns can be either object or subject pronouns.

Compare:

James is creating a database warehouse. To do so, James needs all the dependencies to give James what James needs to start building the database warehouse.

 As you can see in the previous example, the writer repeats the nouns James and Data warehouse more than twice.

The correction of the previous paragraph should be like this:
James is creating a database warehouse. To do so, he needs all the dependencies to give him what he needs to start building it.

Let's see the reason why:

SUBJECT PRONOUNS

The subject is the doer of the action, it can be a person, a thing or an animal. In a text you can use the subject pronoun to replace a previously mentioned subject so that you avoid redundancy.

In the previous example the writer repeats the noun James many times. In order to identify whether the noun is a subject or object pronoun, you need to see where in the sentence it is located.

Subject + verb + object + complement.

The correction of the subject pronouns should look like follows.

James is creating a database warehouse. To do so, he needs all the dependencies to give James what he needs to start building the database warehouse.

If you notice, the sentences he needs all and he needs to refer to James as the subject of the sentences; therefore, you can change it for “he.”

Even though we fixed the redundancy regarding to the subject pronouns, there are still some repeated nouns.

OBJECT PRONOUNS

You use these pronouns to replace the object nouns in the sentence in order to avoid redundancy.
Remember that the object of the sentence is not an animal or inanimate thing; the object is what receives the action in a sentence.

Subject + verb + object + complement.

If we analyze the example, we realize that the repeated objects are James and Warehouse.
James is creating a database warehouse. To do so, he needs all the dependencies to give James what he needs to start building the database warehouse.

The correct version should look like follows.
Jame is creating a database warehouse. To do so, he needs all the dependencies to give him what he needs to start building it.

images.text: Tom: Hi, Tina. I need your help, please I need to know what is happening to our database. The sales manager and the CEO need some specific information from the database, but when I gather it from their computers, it is quite different.
Tina: Ok, I think I know what's happening. We need to implement a data warehouse to organize the whole data of the company.
Tom: I can convince the IT manager to do it if you tell me why it is important for the company.
Tina: Well, the thing is that when there are too many dependencies in a company, the information they have may differ from the others, and that complicates things for all departments.
Tom: Ok… how is data warehousing helping us in the company?

Tina: Well, that's easy. When we use data warehousing, it compiles all the data the company has from its different dependencies and databases. Then, when people need it, they just look for it from their own offices by using the app of the company.
Tom: Hmm, but how does it manage the data?

Tina: Look, data warehouses have some tools and utilities that help the user through the process. For example, when you input a query to the program, it uses a data extraction tool to gather the data from the dependency you are requesting it from. Afterwards, the data cleaning tool corrects any possible errors that it finds in the databases. Once the app finds the information, it converts it by using the data transformation tool.

There are some other important tools like the refreshing and data loading ones. One of their key features is that they permit the data warehouse to update the data from the different databases and consolidate it, so that the data warehouse is always up to date.
Tom: Thanks for the advice Tina, let me see what I can do about it.
